selected.question: when does a Roth 401(k) beat a Traditional 401(k)?

claims.statement: The break-even hinges on your marginal tax rate today versus in retirement, not on account balance.
At a 22% rate now and 24% later, the Roth wins by roughly 3% of ending balance over 30 years.
The crossover flips once expected retirement income drops two brackets below working income.
